LanguageData.GM_MugirlFix: Mugirl: prevent automatic dismount for minor injuries
LanguageData.GM_MugirlFixHelp: Changes only the medical-rest reason inside Mugirl automatic dismount. Adjust the health, bleeding and pain limits above. Defaults: above 80% health, at most 5% bleeding per day, below 30% pain. Disease, labor, surgery, other medical reasons, death, downing, fire, mental state, hunger, fatigue, ropes, and manual/emergency dismount retain original behavior. Does not change medical needs or actual damage. Only applies when Mugirl is installed.
LanguageData.GT_Health: Medical dismount health threshold (%, at or below)
LanguageData.GT_Bleeding: Tolerated bleeding (percent per day; medical dismount above this)
LanguageData.GT_Pain: Medical dismount pain threshold (%, at or above)
